blueprint.name: BNK on a disconnected IBM ROKS cluster (private registry + F5 License Proxy)
blueprint.description: Install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes onto an EXISTING IBM ROKS cluster that has no egress: images come from a private registry you have already mirrored, licensing from an F5 License Proxy. Registers the cluster with BNK Forge first, so it can be watched while BNK installs. Populate the mirror beforehand with the FAR mirror blueprint, or let the Harbor blueprint do it when it builds the registry.

outcomes: The BNK supply chain replicated into your private registry and verified
An existing air-gapped ROKS cluster adopted over the Transit Gateway
BNK installed with every image from the mirror and the License CR Active via the FLP

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. Region and resource group inherit from it.
An existing, private ROKS cluster (no worker egress) on the Transit Gateway, with BNK NOT installed.

A private OCI registry (e.g. Harbor) reachable from both this runner and the cluster's nodes over the Transit Gateway. Its self-signed CA is captured automatically during replicate and installed on the nodes.
A running F5 License Proxy the cluster can reach privately — deploy one with the 'Deploying F5 License Proxy as an IBM Cloud VSI' blueprint, then paste its external_endpoint and root_ca_b64 here.
The existing Transit Gateway joining the cluster VPC to the services VPC holding the registry and the proxy.
An orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT — the only artifacts not served from the mirror.

input_summary.label: Two phases
input_summary.value: Mirror (init -> registry replicate --target generic -> registry verify) then Install (cluster register -> bnk up -> bnk status), sharing one deployment workspace — the same split, and the same shared state, as the demo's two Argo Workflows over one PVC.

input_summary.label: Registry trust
input_summary.value: roksbnkctl captures the mirror's CA from its served chain during replicate, trusts it for the operator's own crane/helm/terraform pulls, and installs it on every worker node via its registry-trust DaemonSet before any image pull. Requires runner >= v1.33.0.

input_summary.label: Known gap
input_summary.value: The demo pairs `bnk up` with a cwc-guard sidecar that clears F5's ReadWriteOnce Multi-Attach deadlock on a REUSED cluster. A Forge container step is a single container with no sidecar, so that guard is not reproduced here — on a cluster where BNK was previously installed, licensing may stall until f5-spk-cwc is cycled by hand.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for resource names roksbnkctl creates (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: cluster_name
required.label: Existing cluster (name or ID)
required.description: Name or ID of the EXISTING ROKS cluster to adopt. It is never created and never destroyed by this blueprint.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region the cluster lives in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: registry_generic_host
required.label: Private registry host
required.description: The private registry (e.g. Harbor) BNK's charts and images are mirrored into and pulled from. For an air-gapped cluster this is its PRIVATE IP or DNS name, reached over the Transit Gateway.

required.name: registry_password
required.label: Registry password
required.description: Password / access token for that user. Stored base64 in the workspace config, never logged.

required.name: flp_external_url
required.label: FLP endpoint
required.description: Licensing endpoint of an F5 License Proxy this cluster does NOT own — `flp output flp_external_endpoint` on the workspace that does.

required.name: flp_root_ca_b64
required.label: FLP root CA (base64)
required.description: That proxy's base64 root CA, which the cluster's CWC must trust — `flp output flp_root_ca`. Already base64: it is stored verbatim.

required.name: cos_bucket
required.label: Supply-chain COS bucket
required.description: Orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT. The runner has no local copies, so it resolves them from here; buckets provisioned by `roksbnkctl init` carry a per-account suffix (bnk-artifacts-<account>).

required.name: registry_ca_b64
required.label: Registry CA (base64)
required.description: Base64 PEM of the private registry's CA. v1.35.0 REFUSES to auto-capture a self-signed mirror's CA over the wire, so supply it here (or pin it below) — this is the CA you generated for the registry.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: Supply-chain COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.label: Registry repository prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key).

optional.name: registry_username

optional.description: Username the mirror is pushed to and pulled from.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: Supply-chain COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: registry_cos_name
optional.label: Registry COS instance name
optional.description: Overrides the registry COS instance `cluster register` looks for. Blank = probe <prefix>-registry-cos, <cluster>-registry-cos, <cluster>-cos. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: registry_ca_sha256
optional.label: Registry CA SHA-256 pin
optional.description: SHA-256 pin of the registry's served chain, enforced during the TLS handshake. Accepts bare hex, sha256:…, colon-separated, or raw `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` output. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_url
optional.label: BNK Forge URL
optional.description: Register the adopted cluster with a BNK Forge instance so it appears on the Kubernetes page (e.g. https://forge.example.com). Blank = skip registration. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_username
optional.label: BNK Forge username
optional.description: Login for that Forge. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_password
optional.label: BNK Forge password
optional.description: Password for that login. Reaches the step as an environment variable only, never on the command line. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_project
optional.label: BNK Forge project
optional.description: BNK Forge project to register the cluster into. Filled automatically with THIS project's name, so the cluster appears on the Kubernetes page of the project you deployed and its scans can be watched as BNK installs.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.label: Skip Forge TLS verification
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate. Defaults to false — verification stays on unless you opt out.

optional.name: flp_namespace
optional.label: FLP namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace the F5 License Proxy client resources go into. Blank keeps the default the subscription JWT implies. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Resolved from the project's credential template when the project is created. Not entered by hand.

optional.name: reachability_retry_seconds
optional.label: Mirror/FLP reachability retry budget (seconds)
optional.description: How long bnk up keeps retrying each preflight target before believing the mirror or the License Proxy is unreachable (roksbnkctl v1.42.0+). Blank = the tool default of 180s, which suits an adopted cluster already attached to the gateway. Raise it if cluster-register has to attach the VPC in this same run, since IBM programs Transit Gateway routes asynchronously. Set 0 for a static environment where a failure is never a race.

optional.name: reachability_timeout_seconds
optional.label: Mirror/FLP reachability overall timeout (seconds)
optional.description: How long bnk up waits for every node to report its verdict. Blank = the tool default of 480s.

optional.name: existing_transit_gateway
optional.label: Existing Transit Gateway (name or ID)
optional.description: Transit Gateway the cluster's VPC is reached over. Supply it when the cluster needs the gateway to reach the private registry and the License Proxy — the usual case. Leave blank when it can already reach them without one, for example when they share the cluster's VPC or it is peered another way. `bnk up` proves every node can reach both before installing, so a wrong answer fails fast and says so.

optional.name: bnkforge_ca_b64
optional.label: BNK Forge CA (base64 PEM)
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the CA that issued the Forge server's certificate, pinning the registration call. Supply this INSTEAD of 'Skip Forge TLS verification': roksbnkctl v1.50.0 warns on every unverified Forge request, and a pin answers that warning rather than silencing it. Blank when the certificate is publicly trusted.

optional.name: cluster_network_mode
optional.label: Cluster network mode
optional.description: How the worker nodes are attached. Blank = single-nic, which is every cluster built so far. multi-nic needs BNK 2.4+; CREATE-time only and enforced.

optional.name: trusted_profile_sa
optional.label: Trusted profile sa
optional.description: The IBM Cloud Trusted Profile the CNE controller assumes to manage its own VPC. Blank derives the account FLO actually creates — leave it blank unless you can also make FLO name that account differently.

optional.name: trusted_profile_roles
optional.label: Trusted profile roles
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TRUSTED_PROFILE_ROLES. Blank applies the terraform default ["Viewer", "Editor"] (tfvar trusted_profile_roles).

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen
optional.description: TMM self-IP masks. INDEPENDENT of the VLAN CIDRs and never derived from them: a mask that deliberately disagrees with its subnet, plus static routes, is how a specific traffic pattern is forced. The per-VLAN pair overrides the shared value; blank inherits.

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen_external
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen external
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_VLAN_PREFIXLEN_EXTERNAL. Blank applies the terraform default 0 (tfvar cneinstance_vlan_prefixlen_external).

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen_internal
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen internal
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_VLAN_PREFIXLEN_INTERNAL. Blank applies the terraform default 0 (tfvar cneinstance_vlan_prefixlen_internal).

optional.name: gtm_url
optional.label: Gtm url
optional.description: The BIG-IP DNS / GTM the GSLB datacenter registers WITH. Without the URL the datacenter name is a label pointing at nothing. The PASSWORD is credential- grade and is routed to the Secret, not the ConfigMap — see SECRET_KEYS.

optional.name: gtm_username
optional.label: Gtm username
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GTM_USERNAME. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_gtm_username).

optional.name: gtm_password
optional.label: Gtm password
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GTM_PASSWORD. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_gtm_password).

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.label: Flo namespace
optional.description: Default f5-bnk and f5-utils. Set BOTH to the same value to install into ONE namespace instead of two — verified working against BNK 2.3. Fewer RBAC surfaces, one NetworkPolicy target, one thing to grant a team. These are an allowlist entry as much as a setting: bnk-env is built from the keys declared in THIS file, so a variable missing here never reaches a workflow no matter what you export.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.label: Flo utils namespace
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_FLO_UTILS_NAMESPACE. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-utils" (tfvar flo_utils_namespace).

optional.name: cneinstance_size
optional.label: Cneinstance size
optional.description: Deployment size for the CNEInstance (Tiny / Small / Medium / …). Blank uses the terraform default. The legal set is a property of the BNK manifest rather than of this tool, so a bad value is rejected by the operator on the cluster rather than here — deliberately, since hardcoding a list would go stale the first time F5 adds a size.

optional.name: gateway_api_mtls
optional.label: Gateway api mtls
optional.description: true installs the Gateway API 1.5.0 standard bundle BNK 2.4 needs for mTLS. Doing so requires deleting the OpenShift ingress-operator's Gateway API ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and its binding, which the platform recreates — the race roksbnkctl's admission sweep exists to win. Blank/false is right for a base install: 2.4's crd-installer logs a graceful skip and leaves the cluster on the bundle OpenShift ships. Ignored on 2.3, where the sweep always runs because the crd-installer IS blocked without it.

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.label: Tmm replicas
optional.description: All 2.4-only. Left empty, terraform applies F5's reference value, so an empty value here is "use the reference" rather than "unset". TMM placement is what REPLACED the node-labeler on 2.4: the labeler was removed as unnecessary and this is the mechanism that took over. The topology keys are the IBM ROKS node labels, surfaced rather than hard-coded.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.label: Watch namespaces
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_WATCH_NAMESPACES. Blank applies the terraform default ["All"] (tfvar cneinstance_watch_namespaces).

optional.name: tmm_anti_affinity
optional.label: Tmm anti affinity
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ANTI_AFFINITY. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_anti_affinity).

optional.name: tmm_anti_affinity_topology_key
optional.label: Tmm anti affinity topology key
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ANTI_AFFINITY_TOPOLOGY_KEY. Blank applies the terraform default "kubernetes.io/hostname" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_anti_affinity_topology_key).

optional.name: tmm_zone_spread
optional.label: Tmm zone spread
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_SPREAD. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_spread).

optional.name: tmm_zone_topology_key
optional.label: Tmm zone topology key
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_TOPOLOGY_KEY. Blank applies the terraform default "topology.kubernetes.io/zone" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_topology_key).

optional.name: tmm_zone_max_skew
optional.label: Tmm zone max skew
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_MAX_SKEW. Blank applies the terraform default 1 (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_max_skew).

optional.name: tmm_zone_when_unsatisfiable
optional.label: Tmm zone when unsatisfiable
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_WHEN_UNSATISFIABLE. Blank applies the terraform default "DoNotSchedule" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_when_unsatisfiable).

optional.name: tmm_pod_label
optional.label: Tmm pod label
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_POD_LABEL. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-tmm" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_pod_label).

optional.name: tmm_rolling_update
optional.label: Tmm rolling update
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ROLLING_UPDATE. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_rolling_update).

optional.name: external_bigip
optional.label: External bigip
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_EXTERNAL_BIGIP. Blank applies the terraform default false (tfvar cneinstance_external_bigip).

optional.name: external_bigip_login_secret
optional.label: External bigip login secret
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_EXTERNAL_BIGIP_LOGIN_SECRET. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-bigip-ctlr-login" (tfvar cneinstance_external_bigip_login_secret).

optional.name: cluster_identifier
optional.label: Cluster identifier
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_CLUSTER_IDENTIFIER. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_cluster_identifier).

optional.name: gateway_api_version
optional.label: Gateway api version
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GATEWAY_API_VERSION. Blank applies the terraform default "1.5.0" (tfvar cneinstance_gateway_api_version).

optional.name: demo_mode
optional.label: Demo mode
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_DEMO_MODE. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_demo_mode).

optional.name: whole_cluster
optional.label: Whole cluster
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_WHOLE_CLUSTER. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_whole_cluster).

optional.name: cert_manager_create
optional.label: Cert manager create
optional.description: Adopt what the cluster already has, rather than creating it. An adopted customer cluster very often already runs cert-manager; without this, bnk up fails with "namespaces cert-manager already exists".

optional.name: registry_cos_create
optional.label: Registry cos create
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_REGISTRY_COS_CREATE. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar create_roks_registry_cos_instance).

optional.name: cluster_jumphosts_create
optional.label: Cluster jumphosts create
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_CLUSTER_JUMPHOSTS_CREATE. Blank applies the terraform default false (tfvar testing_create_cluster_jumphosts).

optional.name: hugepages
optional.label: Hugepages
optional.description: Allocate hugepages on the worker pool. OFF by default: enabling it sets a bootloader kernel argument, so the Machine Config Operator DRAINS AND REBOOTS every matching worker. deploymentSize Tiny needs none; Small wants 4Gi.

optional.name: hugepages_size
optional.label: Hugepages size
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_HUGEPAGES_SIZE. Blank applies the terraform default "2M" (tfvar cneinstance_hugepages_size).

optional.name: hugepages_count
optional.label: Hugepages count
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_HUGEPAGES_COUNT. Blank applies the terraform default 2048 (tfvar cneinstance_hugepages_count).

optional.name: gateway_class_name
optional.label: Gateway class name
optional.description: GatewayClass is CLUSTER-scoped, so two BNK installs sharing a cluster cannot share the name. Blank → "gateway-class", which is right for one install per cluster and wrong for a matrix that stands two up side by side.

optional.name: gateway_controller_name
optional.label: Gateway controller name
optional.description: The string the CNE controller matches ITSELF against. LEAVE THIS BLANK: blank derives "f5.com/<flo_namespace>-f5-cne-controller", which is what a controller this deployment installed calls itself, and it follows a changed ROKSBNKCTL_FLO_NAMESPACE automatically. Set it only to aim the GatewayClass at a controller deployed by something else. A wrong value fails SILENTLY — the apply succeeds, the GatewayClass is never Accepted, and no traffic flows.

optional.name: gateway_route_examples
optional.label: Gateway route examples
optional.description: Extra route kinds to create WORKING examples of, alongside the HTTPRoute the gateway phase always creates. Comma-separated. Blank leaves an existing deployment byte-identical. On BNK 2.3 the only valid values are GRPCRoute and L4Route, and that is not arbitrary: 2.3 pins Gateway API 1.4.1 STANDARD, which contains no TCPRoute, TLSRoute or UDPRoute at all. BNK provides L4Route (gateway.k8s.f5net.com/v1) for TCP instead. Anything else is refused at plan time rather than creating an object no controller will ever claim. Setting L4Route also adds a TCP listener to the Gateway, because an L4Route cannot attach to an HTTP listener.

optional.name: gateway_l4_listener_port
optional.label: Gateway l4 listener port
optional.description: Port for that TCP listener. Blank → 8080.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Cluster Registry
modules.description: Adopt the existing cluster and register it with BNK Forge — first, so it is visible and monitorable while BNK installs.

modules.name: roksbnkctl BNK Install
modules.description: init -> cluster register -> bnk up -> bnk status, pulling from the mirror and licensing via the FLP.

modules.name: cwc Multi-Attach guard
modules.description: Runs in PARALLEL with the BNK install, not before it: the Deployment it fixes only exists once the F5 Lifecycle Operator creates it, part-way through the install. Depends on the cluster registration for the kubeconfig. Leave it enabled — on a cluster that does not need it the patch reports 'no change' and the module is a few seconds of no-ops.
